findings.rationale: core: the reading filter (2.3) and the two-sensor pooling (4.3) hold at every distance, and the carrier isolation kept every trap input in its own file so no bulletin combined them. Added combined.jsonl (sub-noise amplitudes at stations nearer than 10 km and beyond 600 km, sub-noise amplitudes inside pooled two-sensor sites, two-sensor sites off the table) with its own test; the carrier check now allows that one file to hold all three classes. Class swept: the panel's mutant and two sibling branch-integration mutants (pooled list unfiltered, off-table site not pooled) are all rejected on the new witness.

gate.rule: sweep catalog C16 interaction mutants (filter x off-table, filter x pooling, pooling x off-table) kept as regression; candidate verifier_static_checks rule: carrier-isolated trap classes need one file that combines them

findings.rationale: reproduced (a 1.0001e-6 bias scored reward 1). A single exact 1e-6 edge cannot be graded against rounded expectations without one sliver or the other (v9 finding 4 was the false-reject side, v10 finding 2 the false-accept side), and the edge is not the hard thing. The instruction now passes numbers within 1e-6 and fails those more than 2e-6 away; the verifier accepts 1.5e-6 and the stored values sit within 5.1e-8 of a 50-digit recomputation, so neither promise has a sliver. Sweep: a 2.1e-6 bias is rejected and a 0.9e-6 bias accepted.

gate.not_mechanizable: per-task tolerance design; recorded in AGENTS.md section 2 (state an accept bound and a reject bound, grade at the midpoint)
